name: CyclicCompositionCircuitFormation
scientific_claim: Generalization is the expression of a token-map-invariant cyclic composition circuit: the partial training operation table fixes a one-dimensional cyclic coordinate, and training progressively makes held-out logits depend on output_coordinate minus the two operand coordinates.
primitive_inputs: training batch input and target objects formed by exact batch occurrences
evaluation logits formed from the parameter version bound to each evaluation occurrence
evaluation-grid train and validation token-input objects

derived_state.cyclic_constraint_rank: Rank of equations phi(left)+phi(right)-phi(target)=0 over the prime-size operand alphabet, using training facts only.
derived_state.rule_logit_circulant_eta: Fraction of logit variance explained by the cyclic residual phi(output)-phi(left)-phi(right).
derived_state.predicted_table_associativity: Associativity fraction of the complete current prediction table.
derived_state.formation_progress: Bounded composite of circulant logit organization, predicted-table associativity, and current validation expression.

evaluation_grid_source: Inferred from exact evaluation occurrence optimizer steps.
